verdict: Yes. Farm Didi from Amravati pitched an app that trains rural women to run food businesses on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal. Many women want to earn from home cooking, and training plus market access helps them.
angle: Rural and small-town women often have food skills but lack training in hygiene, packaging and selling. Training and support help them build businesses. CSR and self-help group networks fund and spread programmes.
